hooks.name: journal-reminder
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, appends one row to KIRO_JOURNAL.md with the spec, the task and the duration (§14.3, §14.6). Command type — costs no credit. The script reads the Kiro payload on stdin and appends '| <timestamp UTC> | <spec> | <task> | <duration> |' to the journal table, creating the file with its header if missing. Durations the script cannot know stay '-' and are filled by hand or marked TODO(measure) in the narrative entries.
